propositions: DC transport raises JIRAError which is not caught by core modules expecting urllib.error.HTTPError, causing exceptions to escape instead of degrading gracefully
outbound_differ._safe_get_issue cannot classify remotely-deleted issues as _DELETED when raised by DC transport because JIRAError matches neither the 404 check nor the timeout/URLError handler
BackendHTTPError must be declared as a urllib.error.HTTPError subclass in _backend.py to serve as the neutral exception contract across all backends while preserving .code for existing catch clauses

DC transport must translate JIRAError to BackendHTTPError at the adapter boundary (_with_connection_retry choke point) preserving HTTP status codes so existing core exception handlers work without modification

Cloud urllib-based transport must remain unmodified and continue raising urllib.error.HTTPError, which will be caught identically by the same exception handlers that catch the BackendHTTPError subclass
